DAM-25 migrate camellia template and specification pages (#41)

## Summary
- migrate camellia route/navigation structure for template classification/manage and specification template/size-range/classification pages
- add hidden template manage detail, preview, and multi-step editor subpages backed by shared route metadata
- introduce fallback-capable request helpers so the new pages integrate with the shared API client while remaining usable without live auth/data

## Validation

- [x] pnpm build:camellia

- [x] From Template Manage, open the Detail, Preview, and Editor hidden routes and confirm each page renders its dedicated shell.
- [x] Confirm each page shows legacy path, permission, and endpoint metadata plus live/fixture source status.
